text: 1. Cattār'; imāni bhikkhave bhayāni. Katamāni cattāri? Jātibhayaṃ, jarābhayaṃ, vyādhibhayaṃ, maraṇabhayaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayānīti. 120. Cattār'; imāni bhayāni. Katamāni cattāri? Aggibhayaṃ, udakabhayaṃ, rājabhayaṃ, corabhayaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayānānīti. [Kesi]2vaggo dutiyo. [Tass'; uddānam || Kesi javo patodo ca|| nāgaṭhānena pañcamaṃ|| Appamādo ca ārakkho|| vejanīyañ cadve] bhayāti|| 121.
